gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.6114 42.733737)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.6114 42.733737)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.580795 39.573261)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.580795 39.573261)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Ayres Natural Bridge State Park, Douglas, WY'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'Fort DuPont State Park, Delaware City, DE'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

fort_dupont_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-75.580795, 39.573261), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
ayres_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(a.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM 
    ayres_point a,
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(a.geom::geometry, 4326), r.rast)
),
fort_dupont_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(f.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS elevation
  FROM 
    fort_dupont_point f,
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(f.geom::geometry, 4326), r.rast)
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN a.elevation > f.elevation THEN 'Ayres Natural Bridge State Park, Douglas, WY'
    WHEN f.elevation > a.elevation THEN 'Fort DuPont State Park, Delaware City, DE'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS higher_elevation,
  a.elevation AS ayres_elevation,
  f.elevation AS fort_dupont_elevation
FROM 
  ayres_elevation a,
  fort_dupont_elevation f;
